prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo source texture for a low-poly fantasy architectural material
Primary request: Create a seamless, repeatable weathered limestone masonry albedo tile for Eloria's shared architectural material library.
Style/medium: muted painterly low-poly fantasy surface, matching the restrained mottling and medium-scale detail of Eloria's approved stylized ground/desert materials; diffuse albedo only.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat orthographic view filling a square image; tile repeats invisibly across both horizontal and vertical edges; even coursed block distribution with no focal block.
Color palette: softly varied cream, warm light grey and subdued green-grey limestone; weathered and natural, never stark white.
Materials/textures: irregular but orderly medium coursed limestone blocks, modest block-size variation, shallow subdued joints, lightly worn arrises, mild mineral mottling and occasional faint lichen staining; readable at a 2 metre architectural repeat and gameplay camera distance. No prominent hero marks.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse illumination with absolutely no directional lighting.
Constraints: seamless across all four edges; flat albedo; no baked normal, height, roughness or metallic cues; moderate low-poly fantasy detail density.
Avoid: obvious edge seams, grout grid, very dark joints, high contrast, clean new brick, large stones, rubble piles, noisy speckles, sharp cracks, moss clumps, plants, props, shadows, highlights, gradients, perspective, horizon, text, logos, borders, watermark.
